goal: 把不可见的交付能力，变成可沿路线检查的证据

visual_thesis.name: 从能力到可信交付
visual_thesis.statement: 路线决定往哪里走，边界决定谁负责什么，证据决定是否完成，闭环决定能否持续接单。

motifs.purpose: 表达顺序、阶段、风险门和成长
motifs.avoid: 把有先后的内容做成等权卡片墙

motifs.purpose: 表达范围、责任和人机所有权
motifs.avoid: 用颜色分栏代替包含与归属关系

motifs.purpose: 表达信任、完成和验收依据
motifs.avoid: 用徽章、图标或口号冒充可验证事实

motifs.purpose: 表达交付资产如何带来下一次机会
motifs.avoid: 只有圆形装饰但没有方向和输入输出

page_decisions.visual_job: Use one large title and the template brand language
page_decisions.rationale: 用起点式封面邀请观众进入完整旅程
page_decisions.avoid: 技术图标拼贴或履历墙

page_decisions.visual_job: Turn the thesis into one memorable sentence
page_decisions.rationale: 先排除伪购买理由，再落到可交付结果
page_decisions.avoid: 三张并列卡片削弱中心判断

page_decisions.visual_job: Draw one directional route with four alternating stage nodes
page_decisions.rationale: 四模块本质是一条连续交付路径
page_decisions.avoid: 四宫格或新增第五模块

page_decisions.visual_job: Create a strong module divider
page_decisions.rationale: 给第一段留出认知换气
page_decisions.avoid: 在幕封上提前塞方法细节

page_decisions.visual_job: Place a completion record at the center of four connected proof branches
page_decisions.rationale: 毕设只有作为完成证据才产生信任
page_decisions.avoid: 四个无连接卖点卡片

page_decisions.visual_job: Show OK flowing through three unresolved blanks into one responsibility block
page_decisions.rationale: 把未定义事项如何转移成责任画成因果流
page_decisions.avoid: 只列失败清单，不显示责任归属

page_decisions.visual_job: Show a four-step trust pipeline
page_decisions.rationale: 信任来自逐步可验证，而非自我宣称
page_decisions.avoid: 客户头像围绕信任装饰

page_decisions.visual_job: Create a strong module divider
page_decisions.rationale: 从信任问题切换到需求定义
page_decisions.avoid: 在幕封上继续讲上一模块案例

page_decisions.visual_job: Use a large quote with unanswered blanks
page_decisions.rationale: 让观众先感到一句话不是需求
page_decisions.avoid: 直接给出答案，跳过问题张力

page_decisions.visual_job: Use a four-direction scope map around one deliverable task
page_decisions.rationale: 四项共同定义一个可交付任务，并非四个技巧
page_decisions.avoid: 2x2卡片墙或把边界放在中心

page_decisions.visual_job: Show responsibility accumulating through five growing linked nodes
page_decisions.rationale: 报价随责任链累积，而不是按代码量计算
page_decisions.avoid: 等宽价目表或单一金额大字

page_decisions.visual_job: Draw four physical gate symbols across one delivery road
page_decisions.rationale: 四次验收门把风险分段关住
page_decisions.avoid: 普通时间线，缺少门的阻断语义

page_decisions.visual_job: Create a strong module divider
page_decisions.rationale: 进入全篇责任边界的核心章节
page_decisions.avoid: 机器人插画抢走判断主题

page_decisions.visual_job: Connect an AI execution engine to a human judgment compass
page_decisions.rationale: 两者是连接关系，不是竞争关系
page_decisions.avoid: 红蓝对抗擂台或能力评分榜

page_decisions.visual_job: Nest AI execution inside the larger human responsibility boundary
page_decisions.rationale: 包含关系直接说明责任不能外包
page_decisions.avoid: 把人和AI画成等权并列圆

page_decisions.visual_job: Use a two-direction vector contrast
page_decisions.rationale: 速度只放大既有方向
page_decisions.avoid: 只比较快慢，忽略方向

page_decisions.visual_job: Show an evidence stack from code to customer
page_decisions.rationale: 完成度随证据层级逐步增加
page_decisions.avoid: 六枚勾选徽章或一句已完成

page_decisions.visual_job: Create a strong module divider
page_decisions.rationale: 把一次性交付转向持续信用
page_decisions.avoid: 在幕封上提前画完整飞轮

page_decisions.visual_job: Use five numbered self-check questions
page_decisions.rationale: 接单前先连续检查五个边界
page_decisions.avoid: 无顺序问答卡片或人格测试风格

page_decisions.visual_job: Use a five-level upward ladder
page_decisions.rationale: 第一单是逐级降低风险的路径
page_decisions.avoid: 从零直接跳到大单的火箭图

page_decisions.visual_job: Use directional arrows to make the delivery asset flywheel visibly cyclical
page_decisions.rationale: 尾款结束项目，资产继续产生机会
page_decisions.avoid: 无箭头圆环或五张周边卡片

page_decisions.visual_job: Use one closing sentence with ample negative space
page_decisions.rationale: 最后留下值得被交付的信用判断
page_decisions.avoid: 新方法清单、二维码或第二个CTA
